utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. I’m heading out now, so I can check what’s still needed and bring back an update.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll be here when you get back, and we can go over what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check what’s still needed and bring it back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll bring the repair drive over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’ll get it ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Pia, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, but only if the supplies and timing still line up. I’m checking the details now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just keep me posted before it starts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might be a little fuzzy on the details, but I can still help out if you tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies list here, so tell me what’s broken and I’ll check what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, just point me to the first broken thing and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mostly the door latch and that loose panel by the drive. I might be missing one thing, though.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the bracket cleanup and a few loose screws by the back gate. I’ve got the list here, so tell me what you can take and I’ll point you to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the loose screws by the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus. I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Sam. I’ve got a few tools I can bring by if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a big help, Gus. Bring whatever you can, and I’ll sort through what we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the repair drive is still at the community center, near the loading doors.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be helpful, thanks. I’ll head over there and check by the loading doors.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I think it should be right by those loading doors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up pace now. I heard they’re still looking for a few more volunteers this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can ask around and send anyone still free over right after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that’ll help a lot. If anyone’s free, send them over after lunch and I’ll point them to the check-in table.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already figure out what needs fixing, or should I take a look?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I have a couple things in mind, but I can show you where I think the fixes are.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, show me where you think they are.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m on it, Nell. I’ll keep the repair drive moving and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an ear out for updates and let folks know as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep folks posted, Nell, and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the list ready, Uli. Tell me which repair items you want to start with, and I’ll coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can start with the broken fence and the leaky tap.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put those at the top of the list and line up the crew for the fence and tap work.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up again, and folks are actually showing up this time. I heard the hardware shop is matching donations by the hour.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can take the heavier boxes and sort the screws if you grab the tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll grab the tools and head over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is moving forward. If you need me to pass anything along, just say so.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I may take you up on that if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course. Just let me know if anything needs passing along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive. Just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I marked the east side gate and the loose hinge by the back path. Those are the main spots to check first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll check the east gate and that hinge first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive, Hana. What’s the next thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I can take the first step. Do you want me to check the battery connections or the drive belt first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Check the battery connections first, then we can look at the drive belt if that doesn’t fix it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I missed what changed, but I’m here now if you want to catch me up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it. Tell me what changed on the repair drive and I’ll catch up fast.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard there’s a good bit of progress on the repair drive. I’m heading out again later, so I’ll check what’s been said and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s good to hear. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep a wrench handy if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll bring you the latest once I’m back, and if they need that wrench I’ll send you word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Leo. What do you need me to fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the front brake and the wobbly shelf. I can show you when you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m free soon, and I can take a look at both. Show me the brake first, then we’ll check the shelf.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little wary about the schedule and who’s coordinating the repairs. If we can keep it organized, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s coordinating it, and what’s the schedule looking like?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still not clear on that yet, so I’d want a named coordinator and a simple timeline before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey, the repair drive is happening Saturday afternoon, and we could use a few more hands. Come by if you can, and I’ll point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with that Saturday. Just tell me what supplies are still needed and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks. We still need gloves, basic hand tools, and a few buckets if you can swing them, and I’ll put them aside for you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school pickup, but I need a firm time so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do 4:30, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Nell. I’ll keep the repair drive moving and make sure everyone knows what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. Just let me know what still needs fixing, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll keep track of the list and send you the updates as soon as I have them.
